summary_en: Kyuden HD will pay a year-end dividend of 30 yen per share for fiscal year ending March 2027, comprising 25 yen ordinary dividend and 5 yen commemorative dividend, bringing total annual dividend to 55 yen including the 25 yen interim dividend. The commemorative dividend marks the 75th anniversary of Kyushu Electric Power and the establishment of the pure holding company structure.
title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend Forecast Including Kyuden HD Commemorative Dividend
translation_en_brief:
On October 30, 2026, Kyuden Holdings announced its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company will pay a year-end dividend of 30 yen per share, consisting of an ordinary dividend of 25 yen per share and a commemorative dividend of 5 yen per share. Combined with the interim dividend of 25 yen per share already paid by Kyushu Electric Power, the total annual dividend will be 55 yen per share.

The commemorative dividend has been introduced to express gratitude to shareholders for their support and to mark two significant corporate milestones: the 75th anniversary of Kyushu Electric Power's founding and the establishment of Kyuden Holdings as a pure holding company on October 1, 2026. The transition to a pure holding company structure was approved at the shareholders' meeting and represents a new organizational framework for enhanced growth of the Kyuden Group.
